meta.name: mass-ulw
meta.description: Drives dependency-ordered child work through the native workflow tool, one run per phase with retry/amend/send recovery. Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a DAG of tasks, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调度一批互相依赖的子任务,按阶段依次执行,失败自动重试补救
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要让一大批有先后依赖的任务分成多个子任务按序跑完
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must fan out many interdependent tasks across child workers in order

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会把有依赖关系的任务组成 DAG,在 eval 单元里用 workflow 工具按相位分波启动运行,并按需对单个节点做 retry / send / amend 恢复。
howto.when: 当你要求 mass-ulw、任务 DAG,或存在先后依赖的 fan-out 工作时触发;完全独立的并行任务用普通 task 更简单。

say.text: 用 mass-ulw 把审计、重写、校验按依赖顺序跑起来
say.note: 定义并启动一个 run,按波次执行

say.text: 重试这个 run 里失败的 lint 节点,顺便改一下它的提示词
say.note: 只重跑该节点,已完成节点复用结果

say.text: 给正在跑的那个节点发消息,让它别写超出范围的文件
say.note: 消息发给单个子节点,不重启整个 run

howto.what_en: Claude groups dependent tasks into a DAG and runs it through the workflow tool inside an eval cell, one phase per run, with retry/send/amend to recover single nodes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for mass-ulw, a task DAG, or fan-out work with real dependencies; fully independent workers are simpler with plain task spawns.

say_en.text: Run the audit, rewrite, and verify nodes as a mass-ulw DAG
say_en.note: defines and starts one run in waves

say_en.text: Retry the failed lint node in this run and edit its prompt
say_en.note: only that node reruns; completed nodes are reused

say_en.text: Send a message telling the running node to stay in scope
say_en.note: steers one child without restarting the run
